name: Operación Malaya
overview: Young judge Miguel Ángel Torres investigates criminal activities tied to the construction of a luxury hotel in Marbella. Meanwhile, two officers from the Organized Crime and Narcotics Unit arrest a drug trafficker linked to an alleged real estate scheme. A series of wiretaps unravels a complex web of corruption within the local government, eventually exposing one of the most notorious urban scandals in Spain’s history. It all begins when a disgruntled poker player, cheated out of his winnings, seeks revenge by turning to the authorities.
